name: Arlberg-Panoramacamping
beschreibung: Arlberg-Panoramacamping is elevated on a sunny hillside in Pettneu am Arlberg in Tyrol’s scenic Stanzer Valley. Its peaceful vantage point provides sweeping vistas across the craggy peaks of the legendary Arlberg mountain range. Open year-round, the campsite offers well-dimensioned pitches for motorhomes and caravans featuring electricity and water hookups, alongside grassy tent grounds. Guests appreciate modern heated sanitary facilities, ski boot drying rooms, and welcoming communal areas. In winter, the complimentary regional ski bus whisks skiers directly to the world-renowned slopes of Ski Arlberg in St. Anton, while summer invites alpine hikes.
kurzbeschreibung: Year-round panoramic campsite in Pettneu am Arlberg with majestic mountain views and ski bus access.
